prompt_text: I need a dental implant in Kansas City. Which specific dental practices should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Kansas City Missouri for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — I just need one quick detail so I give targeted, reliable recommendations: which part of Kansas City are you closest to (zip code or neighborhood) — KC, MO or KC, KS? Also tell me if you have dental insurance, a budget or timeline, and whether you prefer a specialist (oral surgeon, periodontist, prosthodontist) or a general dentist who places implants.

Why I ask: Kansas City is large and the best practices to call depend on which side of town you’re on, and whether you need sedation, bone grafting or a lower-cost option (dental school).

If you want to move forward now, here are immediate, safe options and exactly what to ask when you call:

Top place to consider right away
- UMKC School of Dentistry Clinic (University of Missouri–Kansas City)
  - Why call: faculty-supervised care, reduced fees, training environment that can handle implants and related procedures (good if budget is a concern). They can do diagnostics and refer to specialists within the clinic.

Types of practices you should call (and why)
- Board-certified Oral & Maxillofacial Surgeons
  - Why: they handle complex placements, extractions, bone grafts/sinus lifts and sedation/general anesthesia.
- Board-certified Periodontists
  - Why: specialists in placing implants and treating gums and bone; excellent for peri-implant health and grafting.
- Prosthodontists
  - Why: specialists in the restorations (crowns/bridges) that go on implants — important for complex full-mouth or cosmetic cases.
- Multi-specialty dental implant centers
  - Why: have surgeons + restorative dentists working together under one roof for faster coordination.
- Dental school clinics (UMKC)
  - Why: lower cost, supervised by experienced faculty.

What to ask when you call (quick checklist)
- Who places the implant (oral surgeon, periodontist, general dentist)? Are they board-certified?
- How many implants like mine have they placed? Can I see before/after photos or patient references?
- Do you use 3D CBCT imaging on-site?
- Which implant brand(s) do you use and why?
- Will I need bone grafting or sinus lift? Is that included in the quote?
- Who will make and place the crown/restoration — in-house or a separate dentist?
- Do you offer sedation or IV sedation if I’m anxious?
- What’s the estimated total cost (surgery + implant + abutment + crown)? Any financing options?
- Do you accept my dental insurance? What portion is typically covered?
- What is the follow-up/warranty policy if complications occur?

If you tell me your ZIP or neighborhood plus any preferences (insurance, budget, sedation), I’ll pull together 6–8 specific dental practices in Kansas City (with phone numbers and brief reasons to call each) so you can start contacting them.
